title: butea peltata
intro: Butea peltata, commonly known as Siris or Kalijiri, is a flowering plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Butea peltata include its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as a diuretic and astringent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
